Tests multi-epoch leader schedule updates, lookup, ordering, limits, and slot queries.

# Purpose
This file is a test program for `fd_multi_epoch_leaders`. It creates an in-memory `fd_multi_epoch_leaders_t` object, feeds it synthetic stake weight messages, and checks that the leader schedules are built and updated correctly across epochs. The helper `generate_stake_msg()` builds test `fd_stake_weight_msg_t` records, and `check_leaders()` verifies that each epoch has the expected slot range and leader distribution.

The test cases cover several behaviors of the multi-epoch leader schedule logic: normal epoch updates, transitions between validator sets, skipped epochs, canceled in-progress updates, leader ordering, next-slot lookup, limit handling for `MAX_STAKED_LEADERS`, and sorted schedule retrieval with `fd_multi_epoch_leaders_get_sorted_lscheds()`. The `main()` function runs all tests and reports `pass` when all checks succeed.
